title: Sr.Game developer
description: About Us: P99soft is at the forefront of providing cutting-edge solutions to global companies, ensuring seamless operations and enhanced efficiency. We are looking for a dynamic and skilled Sr.Game developer to join our team in Hyderabad. What’s in it? We’re looking for a highly talented and dedicated Software Engineer/Programmer who is passionate about developing software systems for games. As a software engineer you will be building the plugins, SDKs and shared libraries that our Unity and Unreal projects are built on, working in small teams that work closely together to create reusable, well- documented solutions that other engineers depend on every day. You will work closely with the engineering lead to plan and streamline how these libraries are built and rolled out, and will provide technical expertise, establishing best practices, and driving innovation within the team. Responsibilities: Collaboratively working with other developers, artists, designers and the rest of the team to deliver well-architected and high-quality cross-platform mobile solutions. Design, build and maintain reusable plugins, SDKs and libraries for Unity and/or Unreal, including the native Android and iOS layers behind them. Own the public API surface of what you ship — versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation paths and upgrade guides for the teams consuming it. Package and distribute libraries through UPM, .unitypackage or Unreal plugin formats, and keep them building cleanly across the engine versions our projects use. Diagnose and resolve the problems specific to library work: dependency and symbol conflicts, engine and OS version fragmentation, build and link failures, and lifecycle or threading mismatches between engine and native code. Write and maintain sample projects, integration documentation and automated tests so teams can adopt your libraries without hand-holding. Collaborate closely with the cross functional game development teams to execute on the roadmap/vision of our games. Estimate engineering effort during multiple stages of product life cycle. Responsible for end-to-end development architecture, thus ensuring the code written to implement the architecture and design meets the highest standards regarding code quality and efficiency. Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques, and evaluate their potential application in the game development process. Take part in regular code and design reviews to maintain consistency across the project. Work closely with the engineering lead to scope, sequence and streamline library development, and to keep what you build aligned with the needs of the consuming project teams. Actively use and refine AI-assisted workflows — code generation, review, test authoring, documentation and tooling — and share what demonstrably works with the team. Plugin & Library Development: This role exists because libraries fail in ways that game code does not. We want someone who has already run into these problems and has opinions about them: Designing a small, clean API surface and keeping it stable as the number of consumers grows. Semantic versioning and managing breaking changes across multiple live projects sitting on different engine versions. Native interop — JNI and Objective-C/Swift bridging, marshalling, and memory ownership across the managed/native boundary. Dependency and transitive dependency conflicts: Gradle/AAR collisions, duplicate symbols, CocoaPods and Swift Package version pinning. Build system integration: Gradle templates, Xcode post-process build steps, Unreal .Build.cs and .uplugin configuration. Threading and lifecycle correctness — main-thread marshalling, application pause/resume, and background callbacks re-entering managed code. Debugging failures inside a consumer’s project that you cannot reproduce locally: logging strategy, symbolication and crash triage. Binary size, startup cost, and the implications of code stripping, IL2CPP or equivalent on what you ship. Keeping up with editor tooling changes and first-party SDK and policy churn without breaking downstream projects. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in game/application development for mobile platforms (Android and iOS) using Unity and/or Unreal. Demonstrable experience building and shipping plugins, SDKs or shared libraries that were consumed by other teams or external partners. Strong C++ and C# skills, with solid architectural and software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on native platform development in at least one of Android (Java/Kotlin, JNI, Gradle) or iOS (Objective-C/Swift, Xcode build phases, CocoaPods). Knowledge of common data structures and algorithmic solutions. Experience with profiling and debugging mobile applications. Understanding of Crashlytics and Google Play console. Understanding of mobile application development guidelines defined by first parties (Apple and Google). Familiarity with source control, CI and automated build pipelines for producing and publishing library artifacts. Excellent written, verbal communication skills and critical thinking skills — for this role, documentation is part of the deliverable. A genuine passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry. Demonstrated interest or hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows (Copilot, Claude, Cursor or similar), and the ability to adapt AI tools into day-to-day workflows to improve productivity — including judgement about where they help, where they do not, and how to review their output critically. Good to Have: Shipped titles live on Android or iOS. Gameplay systems experience — Finite State Machines, Behaviour Trees, animation or physics integration. Editor tooling: custom inspectors, importers or build automation in Unity or Unreal. Rendering awareness — shaders, batching, draw call and overdraw budgets. Integrating third-party game SDKs such as analytics, ads, IAP or attribution. Performance work on low-end devices: memory budgets, GC pressure and frame pacing. Open-source contributions Why Join Us? Opportunity to work on cutting-edge data and AI initiatives. Collaborative and innovation-driven work culture. Exposure to enterprise-scale cloud and analytics projects. Career growth and leadership opportunities. P99soft is an equal-opportunity employer: P99soft is an equal-opportunity employer. At P99soft, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of job history, disability, gender identity, religion, race, color, caste, marital/parental status, veteran status, or any other special status. We stand against the discrimination of employees and individuals and are proud to be an equitable workplace that welcomes individuals from all walks of life if they fit the designated roles and responsibilities. Life@P99soft: At P99soft, we believe in creating a work environment that balances professional excellence with personal well-being. Our vibrant office culture is built on mutual respect, inclusivity, and a shared passion for innovation. We host regular team-building activities, workshops, and social events to foster a sense of community and collaboration among our employees. Join us and be part of a team that values your contributions and supports your growth About Us: P99soft is a leading IT Services and IT Consulting company dedicated to making our customers’ business operations seamless by providing them with digital services and applications using the latest technologies. We are committed to bringing excellence to all our creations. We need passion, empathy, and being customer-focused to achieve technical excellence. We believe in transparency through open communication and work with honesty and integrity while dealing with our customers and partners. Our Vision: “To lead digital transformation for our customers, delighting them at every step, while empowering our employees and fostering success.” Our Mission: “To attain our objectives within a framework of integrity, transparency, and respect for our clients, employees, partners, and the community, fostering mutual trust and sustainable growth.” Journey towards digital transformations begins here. Our engineering teams take complete ownership of assigning the right talent and architecting solutions using the latest technologies.

title: Sr.Game developer
description: About Us: P99soft is at the forefront of providing cutting-edge solutions to global companies, ensuring seamless operations and enhanced efficiency. We are looking for a dynamic and skilled Sr.Game developer to join our team in Hyderabad. What’s in it? We’re looking for a highly talented and dedicated Software Engineer/Programmer who is passionate about developing software systems for games. As a software engineer you will be building the plugins, SDKs and shared libraries that our Unity and Unreal projects are built on, working in small teams that work closely together to create reusable, well- documented solutions that other engineers depend on every day. You will work closely with the engineering lead to plan and streamline how these libraries are built and rolled out, and will provide technical expertise, establishing best practices, and driving innovation within the team. Responsibilities: Collaboratively working with other developers, artists, designers and the rest of the team to deliver well-architected and high-quality cross-platform mobile solutions. Design, build and maintain reusable plugins, SDKs and libraries for Unity and/or Unreal, including the native Android and iOS layers behind them. Own the public API surface of what you ship — versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation paths and upgrade guides for the teams consuming it. Package and distribute libraries through UPM, .unitypackage or Unreal plugin formats, and keep them building cleanly across the engine versions our projects use. Diagnose and resolve the problems specific to library work: dependency and symbol conflicts, engine and OS version fragmentation, build and link failures, and lifecycle or threading mismatches between engine and native code. Write and maintain sample projects, integration documentation and automated tests so teams can adopt your libraries without hand-holding. Collaborate closely with the cross functional game development teams to execute on the roadmap/vision of our games. Estimate engineering effort during multiple stages of product life cycle. Responsible for end-to-end development architecture, thus ensuring the code written to implement the architecture and design meets the highest standards regarding code quality and efficiency. Stay up to date with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques, and evaluate their potential application in the game development process. Take part in regular code and design reviews to maintain consistency across the project. Work closely with the engineering lead to scope, sequence and streamline library development, and to keep what you build aligned with the needs of the consuming project teams. Actively use and refine AI-assisted workflows — code generation, review, test authoring, documentation and tooling — and share what demonstrably works with the team. Plugin & Library Development: This role exists because libraries fail in ways that game code does not. We want someone who has already run into these problems and has opinions about them: Designing a small, clean API surface and keeping it stable as the number of consumers grows. Semantic versioning and managing breaking changes across multiple live projects sitting on different engine versions. Native interop — JNI and Objective-C/Swift bridging, marshalling, and memory ownership across the managed/native boundary. Dependency and transitive dependency conflicts: Gradle/AAR collisions, duplicate symbols, CocoaPods and Swift Package version pinning. Build system integration: Gradle templates, Xcode post-process build steps, Unreal .Build.cs and .uplugin configuration. Threading and lifecycle correctness — main-thread marshalling, application pause/resume, and background callbacks re-entering managed code. Debugging failures inside a consumer’s project that you cannot reproduce locally: logging strategy, symbolication and crash triage. Binary size, startup cost, and the implications of code stripping, IL2CPP or equivalent on what you ship. Keeping up with editor tooling changes and first-party SDK and policy churn without breaking downstream projects. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in game/application development for mobile platforms (Android and iOS) using Unity and/or Unreal. Demonstrable experience building and shipping plugins, SDKs or shared libraries that were consumed by other teams or external partners. Strong C++ and C# skills, with solid architectural and software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on native platform development in at least one of Android (Java/Kotlin, JNI, Gradle) or iOS (Objective-C/Swift, Xcode build phases, CocoaPods). Knowledge of common data structures and algorithmic solutions. Experience with profiling and debugging mobile applications. Understanding of Crashlytics and Google Play console. Understanding of mobile application development guidelines defined by first parties (Apple and Google). Familiarity with source control, CI and automated build pipelines for producing and publishing library artifacts. Excellent written, verbal communication skills and critical thinking skills — for this role, documentation is part of the deliverable. A genuine passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry. Demonstrated interest or hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows (Copilot, Claude, Cursor or similar), and the ability to adapt AI tools into day-to-day workflows to improve productivity — including judgement about where they help, where they do not, and how to review their output critically. Good to Have: Shipped titles live on Android or iOS. Gameplay systems experience — Finite State Machines, Behaviour Trees, animation or physics integration. Editor tooling: custom inspectors, importers or build automation in Unity or Unreal. Rendering awareness — shaders, batching, draw call and overdraw budgets. Integrating third-party game SDKs such as analytics, ads, IAP or attribution. Performance work on low-end devices: memory budgets, GC pressure and frame pacing. Open-source contributions Why Join Us? Opportunity to work on cutting-edge data and AI initiatives. Collaborative and innovation-driven work culture. Exposure to enterprise-scale cloud and analytics projects. At P99soft, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of job history, disability, gender identity, religion, race, color, caste, marital/parental status, veteran status, or any other special status. We stand against the discrimination of employees and individuals and are proud to be an equitable workplace that welcomes individuals from all walks of life if they fit the designated roles and responsibilities. description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs. Must have skills : Automotive ECU Software Good to have skills : NA Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer with 5–6 years of hands-on experience to develop firmware for a next-generation, battery-powered Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) sensor platform. The role is strongly focused on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), TPMS sensing and data transmission, low-power operation, and production-grade embedded C. Roles & Responsibilities: Develop and maintain embedded C firmware for resource-constrained TPMS sensor devices and receiver-side embedded modules or ECUs. Implement TPMS application logic, including product state machines, measurement scheduling, sensor validation and filtering, diagnostics, and recovery. Design BLE advertising flows for TPMS data, including GAP/GATT behavior, payload construction, OEM/customer-specific encoding, transmission timing, and Tx-power considerations. Develop receiver-side firmware to receive, decode, validate, and process TPMS wireless packets, including sensor identification and association, message-integrity checks, signal-quality handling, diagnostics, and fault recovery. Integrate pressure, temperature, acceleration, and battery-voltage sensing with BLE/radio, timers, NVM, diagnostics, and firmware-update services. Optimize battery life using sleep/deep-sleep modes/LPM, wake-up sources, event-driven execution, and low-power measurement and transmission cycles. Bring up, debug, and validate both sensor-side and receiver-side firmware on prototype hardware using JTAG, UART logs, vendor tools, and test setups, while collaborating with hardware, systems, and validation teams. Professional & Technical Skills: 5–6 years of embedded firmware development experience, with strong hands-on C programming for microcontrollers. Practical BLE experience, especially advertising, GAP, GATT, payload limits and formats, Tx power, RSSI, and low-power wireless trade-offs. Experience with TPMS or automotive sensor-and-receiver systems involving pressure, temperature, acceleration, battery-voltage monitoring, motion detection, wireless data reception and diagnostics. Experience developing firmware for receiver- or ECU-side embedded systems, including packet reception and decoding, sensor pairing or identification, data validation, diagnostics, and integration with vehicle or host software. Strong MCU fundamentals, including interrupts, timers, watchdogs, memory constraints, fault handling, layered architecture, HAL, and driver abstractions. Hands-on experience with UART, I2C, SPI, GPIO, ADC, flash, NVM, CAN/LIN, JTAG/debug probes, vendor SDKs, build tools, and Git. Experience with low-power battery-operated devices, bootloaders, firmware updates, configuration management, static analysis, and production-oriented debugging. Additional Information: The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automotive ECU Software. This position is based at our Hyderabad office. A 15 years full time education is required.
